commands.command: Use the M141 critical-key guard as a pre-screen for any repair candidate that tries to improve M136/M128 fixed losses.
commands.name: m142_guarded_candidate_prescreen

commands.command: Try a minimal repair path, such as interpolation or lower-step objective updates, and admit only candidates that pass the M141 guard before strict miners.
commands.name: m142_minimal_guarded_repair

decision_rule: Proceed to expensive strict miners only if a candidate improves or preserves fixed losses while passing the M141 critical-key guard and behavior retention.
failure_criteria: candidate fails the M141 critical-key guard
candidate only passes by reverting to M132 with no measurable fixed-loss benefit
candidate changes actor observations or uses hidden/oracle policy inputs
hypothesis: A critical-key pre-screen can prevent near-threshold rollout proof-surface regressions while allowing very small fixed-loss improvements.
success_criteria: candidate preserves behavior success and zero-response degradation
fixed M136/M128 loss does not regress materially
strict miner is run only after the cheap guard passes
